claim_boundary: Offline retrospective screening only. No live control, setpoint, safety limit, site recommendation, reserve estimate, bankability conclusion, or external validation is produced.

forge1683_walk_forward.interpretation: The earlier single holdout 8-12% flow result is not stable across all chronological regimes. Simple smoothing remains useful in some regimes but must not be promoted as universal superiority.

forge1683_sensor_robustness.interpretation: The simple flow smoother is comparatively robust to synthetic missingness and noise, especially at 30-60 minute horizons, under the tested forward-fill corruption protocol.

forge1683_distribution_drift.interpretation: The circulation record is strongly nonstationary. Static thresholds and fixed model assumptions can become invalid as the operating regime evolves.

forge1683_causal_drift_abstention.interpretation: A causal drift-triggered fallback modestly improves mean performance and eliminates selected negative blocks after warm-up at 30 and 60 minutes in this historical record. The 10-minute rule still fails once and remains a hold lane. This is a model-selection experiment, not an operating-control rule.

forge1149_state_forecasting_negative.interpretation: The tested state-aware Ridge model is decisively worse than persistence for short-horizon pressure forecasting. Historical path-dependence remains a diagnostic hypothesis only.

noaa_ndbc_wave.interpretation: The wave edge remains local and simple. Rich local features and cross-station models did not clear the 5% promotion threshold. Mild missingness preserves much of the 46237 local-smoothing edge; severe missingness degrades it.

usgs_geothermal_evidence_reconciliation.interpretation: Relative to the full-data per-site median consensus reference, median reconciliation is substantially more stable under synthetic estimator dropout than mean or trimmed-mean reconciliation. The consensus reference is not physical ground truth.

usgs_resource_uncertainty_frontier.interpretation: Penalizing uncertainty reduces dispersion but also sacrifices expected score. The result is a measurable risk-return frontier, not a universal best ranking or a site recommendation.

priority_wedges: drift-aware fail-closed forecasting and model-validity monitoring for geothermal operations data
sensor-quality and missing-data resilience validation for geothermal analytics
robust reconciliation of conflicting geothermal resource estimates under incomplete evidence
uncertainty-aware resource portfolio/ranking analytics with explicit risk-return tradeoffs
local short-horizon wave-resource forecasting where station-specific evidence clears a frozen baseline
hold_or_negative_lanes: short-horizon FORGE1149 state-aware pressure forecasting with the tested Ridge model
10-minute geothermal drift-abstention as a fully fail-closed lane
